result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may terminate on 30 days' written notice, receives a refund of prepaid fees allocable to the post-termination period, and Licensor has no convenience-termination right during a committed term. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” exceeds the playbook and may alter scope, pricing, and operational obligations without addressing the consequences of partial termination. The new subsection is also placed after Article XXI despite being numbered “IV,” creating structural ambiguity. These issues make the redline broader than necessary and reduce drafting quality.
